company.description:
Feather provides employers and employees with a suite of financial benefits: 401(k), HSA, FSA, stock plan, 529, brokerage account, and banking - all with a single integration. That means, you spend less time integrating, pay less money for individual subscriptions, and hire faster with all the financial benefits with 1-click.

For employers, Feather aims to reduce time administering these benefits by 20-30%, while saving the overall cost of these benefits through bundles
For employees, Feather provides a better understanding and management tools for their financial benefits through a unified modern platform

Feather is committed to building financial tools and resources for a healthier future of American economy through workplace financial benefits
